positions.title: Software Developer - Maps Data Test Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
- GIS
- Continuous Integration
- Test automation (git, Jenkins, Groovy, Java, JavaScript, JSON)
- Develop, maintain and test modular code and supporting libraries, written to be utilized by multiple engines which validate large data sets in a cross-functional team
- Support data creation, ingestion, transformation, and publication initiatives
- Evaluate failures and assess scope of scripts through an end-to-end write, test, deliver model
- Utilize working knowledge of multiple internal and external tools to test execution of code against live data
- Operate within the paradigm of strict standards, differing ingest processes, and evolving data model; communicate, commit and report efficiently and effectively.
- Write maintainable and scalable code in and lead two teams concurrently. 
- Promoted to Team Lead after 4 months, asked to take on additional responsibilities of Critical Bugs Team Lead after 6 months while still responsible for individual code development and code lifecycle / promotion within teams
- Mentoring junior members and act as directly responsible person and knowledge resource

positions.title: QA Engineer - Operational Support Systems (OSS)
positions.description:
Close to the heart of operations while maintaining a connection to the user experience: The maintenance and feature team in OSS fulfilled requests regarding user interfaces with our products (including both internal and external customers).
- Responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of applications that interface with AT&T Wi-Fi's network devices and the representation and manipulation of live data and configurations. 
- Frequently integrated with the Network Systems Support team, code released from OSS also concerned NMDs in the field, heavily driven by data and reliant on database management in a live and evolving environment. 
- As a QA member on this team, responsible for the performance of any and all functions involved in the testing of new and existing PHP and .NET user interface applications, a deeper understanding of the underlying data model that supports a large enterprise was required.
- Spectrum of individual contributions: 
-- Assisted the test automation team by designing, executing, and troubleshooting automated regression tests
-- Worked closely with development team members and product owners to build robust test suites to address test case deficit and attain full coverage on all applications within this team's scope
-- Maintained a working knowledge of dependencies, requested functionality, and long term product scalability of all current and future applications.  
-- Unit testing and user acceptance testing during the design, development, and release process
-- Utilized version control, build tools, and automated test suites to complete projects in an Agile work environment
-- Managed the communication and verification of change requests between engineering and IT
-- Managed the Dev and Staging environments of UI tools, and playing the role of DBA for my team
-- Managed the database environments (DBA) of all QA teams at At&t Wi-Fi

positions.title: QA Engineer -  Business Support Systems (BSS)
positions.description:
The business objects, reporting, and data mining team. 
- Responsible for the management of test suites and test cases 
- Assisted BSS initiatives of developing accurate and adaptable reporting and data presentation software using SAP Business Intelligence tool for an exponentially growing company.  
- Contributed to process improvement and the development of better software development methods 
- Worked with managers, product owners, team leads, and peers to streamline efforts of release cycles, and effective in assisting all members involved. 
- Innovative and capable of producing aggressive test cases for multiple teams utilizing a working knowledge of ETL, data warehousing, business objects, data mining, Agile methodology, TDD, and QA best practices and approaches. 
- Moved from entry level to a team lead in under a year
- Responsible for teaching new members the processes and procedures necessary to aid an organization in developing reliable, efficient, and competitive products before accepting a more challenging position
- Demonstrated ability to multitask and leverage several ongoing projects while maintaining attention to detail to meet priority and emergency deadlines while committing to best practices and continuing to educate and grow my knowledge and skill base

positions.title: Independent Contractor, Copy Editor
positions.description:
Apr 2011-Aug 2011: Independent Contractor, Copy Editor - Principle editor of graduate-level textbooks covering computer science, physics, astronomy, mathematics, and chemistry written in LaTeX.  Meet publisher’s standards and qualifications within deadline.  Contacted by publisher with a job offer and a raise.

2007-2009: Independent Contractor, Copy Editor - Principal editor of scientific journal articles covering computer science, physics, astronomy, mathematics, and chemistry written in LaTeX.  Managed multiple deadline-sensitive journal articles at once.  Reason for leaving: fewer journal articles to edit, paid internship in US.

positions.title: Funded undergraduate research positions
positions.description:
Funded research project with Chairman of the UT Astronomy Department, Dr. Neal Evans - searched and analyzed Herbig-Haro objects in a star forming region.  Coded a routine using Interactive Data Language (IDL) to compute spectral data. (Jan 2008 – Jan 2011)

Funded research project with Chairman of the UT Astronomy Department, Dr. Neal Evans - analyzed Young Stellar Objects Candidates (YSOc), distinguished false alerts from real objects, and processed raw image data to produce usable .fits files.  (Sept 2007 – Dec 2010)

Successfully coded a procedure using IDL that overlays two imaged simulations of the death of a Population III star without loss of information, as assistant researcher to Dr. Volker Bromm.  Wrote extensive programs in C, C++, and IDL to handle calculations and visualization. Presented preliminary findings at the Undergraduate Research Forum. Presented final results at the Bash Symposium (Dec 2006 – Dec 2007)

Collaborated with a team of scientists lead by Dr. Don Winget to catalog positions of White Dwarf Stars in the universe using photometric and astrometric techniques in IRAF (Dec 2005 - Dec 2006)
Worked with the leading GRB Theorist Dr. Pawan Kumar at UT and maintained a database to store all known GRBs ever discovered.  (May 2006)

Worked with the leading GRB Theorist Dr. Pawan Kumar at UT and maintained a database to store all known GRBs ever discovered.  (May 2006)

company.name: University of Texas Austin Department of Astronomy

positions.title: Funded Internship
positions.description: Funded research position in Dr. Jochen Greiner’s group, Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics, Germany - Searched for High-Redshift Quasar candidates and calculated spectral energy distributions using Bash, SQL and C++, producing upper limits via the GROND data reduction pipeline technology, to which I improved upon with new scripts. (July 2008 - Oct 2008)

company.name: Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics

positions.title: Funded Internship
positions.description: Research in Science and Engineering (RISE) – Funded by Deutscher Akademischer Austausch-Dienst (DAAD): Gamma Ray Burst (GRB) astronomy at Thüringer Landessternwarte Tautenburg (TLS), Tautenburg, Germany, under Dr. Sylvio Klose. Wrote an extensive program to solve for k-corrections and isotropic energy distributions, including error propagation (still in use).  Collaborated internationally to write and submit a paper to the leading journal NATURE and proposals for GROND.  (Jun 2007 - Aug 2007)
